title: Process String with Special Operations I
summary: Given a string s with lowercase English letters and special characters *, #, and %, construct a new string result by appending letters, removing the last character if '*', duplicating the result if '#', and reversing the result if '%', all processed from left to right.
statement: Given a string s with lowercase English letters and special characters *, #, and %, construct a new string result by appending letters, removing the last character if '*', duplicating the result if '#', and reversing the result if '%', all processed from left to right.
constraints: Letters append, * removes the last character when present, # duplicates, and % reverses.
hints: Each token transforms only the current result.
Simulate with a mutable character list.
Append, pop conditionally, extend by itself, or reverse according to the token.
Applying the four exact transformations in input order reproduces the specified state after every prefix.
editorial: Applying the four exact transformations in input order reproduces the specified state after every prefix.

tests.explanation: The states a, aa, aab, baa, ba produce ba.
Removing z leaves an empty string that remains empty when duplicated.
